settings.text: You have questions? We have answers.

settings.title: What is Lamiderm Apex?
settings.content: Lamiderm Apex is a revolutionary skin care serum for women and men. It’s designed for adults of all ages who want healthy and youthful-looking skin.

settings.title: How often should Lamiderm Apex be used?
settings.content: For the best results, Lamiderm Apex should be used everyday in the morning and evening on clean, dry skin.

settings.title: Is Lamiderm Apex an anti-aging product?
settings.content: Lamiderm Apex is a skin care serum for women and men who want to achieve healthier, more radiant looking skin and target existing skin damage such as age spots and wrinkles. The exclusive Fertilized Avian Egg Extract has been shown in a scientifi c study using human skin cells to support all three main components of the Extracellular Matrix (ECM): elastin, collagen and fi bronectin for youthful, supple skin at any age.

settings.title: What makes Lamiderm Apex unique compared to other skin care products?
settings.content: Lamiderm Apex is the first skin care product with the naturally occurring lysyl oxidase (LOX) enzyme from Fertilized Avian Egg Extract and two bio-active growth factors. The LOX enzyme is plentiful in youthful skin and helps to link small collagen and elastin fibers together for longer and stronger fibers. In turn, skin looks and feels smoother, healthier and more youthful. Lamiderm Apex also targets the production of a third fiber, called fibronectin, which supports reduction in the look of scar tissue. Most skin care serums target only one or two of these fibers, but only the LifePharm Fertilized Avian Egg Extract in Lamiderm Apex is specially formulated to improve all three.

settings.title: Has Lamiderm Apex been tested for safety?
settings.content: Yes, Lamiderm Apex has been tested for safety. It is formulated without harmful sulfates, synthetic fragrances and is hypoallergenic. LamidermApex is made in the U.S.A. As with all our products, we are dedicated to using research-based ingredients for the highest-quality formulation. Lamiderm skin care is backed by the same 100 percent Confi dence Guarantee as LifePharm supplements.

settings.title: What are the main benefits of Lamiderm Apex?
settings.content: Lamiderm Apex revitalizes skin’s natural elasticity, firmness and results in a healthy glow. It actively brightens and beautifies the look of the skin, while effectively supporting repair from UV damage and pollution. The LifePharm Fertilized Avian Egg Extract in Lamiderm Apex has been shown to support elastin, fibronectin and collagen production in human skin cells.

settings.title: What are the ingredients in Lamiderm Apex?
settings.content: The main ingredient in the Lamiderm Apex serum is the proprietary LifePharm Fertilized Avian Egg Extract, which naturally contains the LOX enzyme. In addition, the rich serum is infused with the Radiance Complex, Protection and Repair Complex, Nourishing Complex and the Deep Delivery System.

settings.title: What is the Radiance Complex?
settings.content:
Radiance Complex is one of the most superior brightening ingredient blends available. It is composed of the extracts from seven Swiss Alpine plants known for their ability to resist harsh environmental conditions: Mentha Piperita (Peppermint) extract; Primula Veris (Cowslip, Primrose); Alchemilla Vulgaris (Lady’s Mantle); Melissa Offi cinalis (Lemon Balm); Veronica Offi cinalis (Gypsy weed, Speedwell); Malva Sylvestris (Mallow); and Achillea Millefolium (Yarrow) extract. The Radiance Complex has been shown to help brighten the complexion and fade the look of 

discoloration on all types of skin, particularly age spots.

settings.title: What is the Protection and Repair Complex?
settings.content:
The Protection and Repair Complex is a combination of fi ve fruit extracts: cranberry, pomegranate, blueberry, strawberry and kiwi. These five

fruit extracts stimulate cell vitality, restore skin texture and resist damage from pollution and UV radiation.

settings.title: What is the Nourishing Complex?
settings.content: Nourishing Complex is a combination of CoQ10 with vitamins C and E, clinically proven to plump and soften the look of fi ne lines and wrinkles. Studies have shown vitamins C and E are the best vitamin antioxidants in protecting skin from UV oxidative damage. When blended with CoQ10, this unique complex strengthens cells against photo-aging and enhances overall skin health.

settings.title: What is the Deep Delivery System?
settings.content: The Deep Delivery System is a blend of Aloe Vera juice, coconut oil and sunfl ower seed oil. This plant-based system allows all the ingredients in Lamiderm Apex to penetrate the skin’s surface, softening the texture for better absorption without irritation.

settings.title: Are there any adverse effects to Lamiderm Apex?
settings.content: Users have not reported any adverse effects. If you are allergic to eggs, please consult your physician before using Lamiderm Apex. If you have sensitive skin or skin allergies, consult your physician/dermatologist prior to use.

settings.title: How do I apply Lamiderm Apex High Performance Bio-Skin Serum?
settings.content: Always apply Lamiderm Apex serum to a clean face that has been patted dry with a towel. Pump one or two pumps of Lamiderm Apex into the palm of your hand. Evenly distribute the serum on both cheeks, forehead, and chin and rub in circular motions. Pat the serum into your skin for maximum absorption. Apply the remainder of serum to the neck and chest area. Finish with a thin layer of your favorite moisturizer, and sunscreen if you are applying in the daytime.

settings.title: When is the best time to apply Lamiderm Apex serum?
settings.content: The serum is best applied twice a day. During the nighttime,  the lightweight serum can penetrate the skin and work while you are sleeping formaximum benefits. Lamiderm Apex may also be applied in the morning under a moisturizer and make-up, since the formula absorbs into the skin quickly with no sticky residue.
